reason: The first prepared upload of the completed archive failed during preparation. Its size exceeded 512 MiB by 962776 bytes; this suggested a size-limit failure, although the service did not state a cause.
preservation: Every transcription, evidence image and other existing member retains its uncompressed bytes; only this packaging record, the repacking script and appended progress entry are new or updated.
strategy: For each unchanged member choose the shortest verified raw DEFLATE stream among original zlib level 6, Zopfli 1 iteration, and libdeflate level 12. New or changed documentation uses zlib level 9.
verification: scripts/recompress_zip.py verifies every complete archive member against its current edition file and verifies all 24 frozen transcription SHA-256 values before accepting the replacement. It also requires standard ZIP method 8 for every member.
